function.name: checks_check
function.description: Run an approved public command by index in a disposable copy.

function.name: checks_diff
function.description: Review a Git diff of current workspace edits.

function.name: checks_edit
function.description: Apply a SHORT source edit with current SHA-256 from focus. replace consumes old and inserts new. before/after KEEP old; new is ONLY the insertion. old must match uniquely; uniform LF/CRLF is adapted to source endings, never fuzzy matched. For repeated anchors supply location={evidence_key: focus.evidence_key, line: inspected line, end_line: optional inclusive last line}; old must match exactly once within those inspected lines. Stale hashes/locations fail. After three equivalent failures use a DIFFERENT unique anchor or inspected location; another equivalent failure stops inference, even after reinspection. create requires expected_sha256=absent and old empty. Python results must parse.

function.name: checks_focus
function.description: Discover qualified symbols and read bounded source (60 lines, 3000 UTF-8 bytes). query is a case-insensitive literal substring of a qualified symbol or source line. Use symbol=Class.method for exact lookup. Follow next_line; unchanged repeated excerpts are suppressed.
